evaluated-on-device.statement: A device posture profile is a set of criteria evaluated on the device, and policies in both Internet & SaaS and Private Access can act on the outcome.

quotes: The Device Posture profile is a set of criteria evaluated on devices. You can configure policies in both Internet & SaaS and Private Access based on the outcome of this evaluation.

trust-level-shown.statement: A device's details page shows its Device Trust Level, Low, Medium, High or Unknown, based on the levels configured in Internet & SaaS posture profiles.

quotes: Device Trust Level: Displays the device trust level based on the configured levels in Internet & SaaS posture profiles. Trust levels are Low, Medium, High, or Unknown.

zia-posture-profile.statement: An app profile, on each platform's policy page (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android), can apply an Internet & SaaS (ZIA) posture profile.

posture-and-forwarding.title: Whether posture results feed forwarding or app-profile selection
posture-and-forwarding.detail: Unverified legacy statement: there is no direct link between a posture profile and a forwarding profile or web policy in the ZCC object model; posture is consumed only downstream by ZPA and ZIA policy, and trusted networks are a separate signal. The app profile does reference a ZIA posture profile, and the company settings carry `enablePostureBasedProfile` and `postureBasedService` with no documented meaning.
posture-and-forwarding.blocks: answering whether a posture change can change a device's app profile or forwarding
